user.title: Set up Level Watch
user.description: Lengths in cm. A sensor in % is kept in %: references, thresholds and the card then work in %.

data_description.name: Shown as device name, e.g. Rhine Cologne or Cistern.
data_description.source_entity: Sensor that delivers the level or the distance to the surface.
data_description.source_unit: Automatic uses the unit of the sensor. A length (mm, cm, m …) is converted to cm; % stays %.
data_description.kind: Water level (river, pond, well) or tank (cistern, heating oil).
data_description.measurement_mode: Level: the sensor reports the height of the surface. Distance: the sensor is mounted on top and measures down to the surface (ultrasonic, radar).
data_description.sensor_height: Only for distance measurement: height of the sensor above the reference zero (e.g. tank bottom).
data_description.offset: Added to every value (in cm, or % for a sensor in %), e.g. to correct the gauge zero.
data_description.reference_min: Level that counts as 0 % (empty or lowest level). For a sensor in %: usually 0.
data_description.reference_max: Level that counts as 100 % (full). Leave empty for no percentage; for a sensor in % it defaults to 100.

tank.name: Tank
tank.description: Only for type Tank. With the shape Level Watch computes litres, consumption and range. Reference zero is the tank bottom.

data_description.shape: None: no volume, only height and percentage.
data_description.length: Inner length, for a horizontal cylinder and a box.

error.height_required: Distance measurement needs the mounting height.
error.max_below_min: The top reference must be above the bottom reference.
error.unit_unknown: The sensor has no length unit. Choose the unit manually.
error.tank_vertical_cylinder: A vertical cylinder needs the diameter.
error.tank_horizontal_cylinder: A horizontal cylinder needs diameter and length.
error.tank_box: A box needs length and width.
error.percent_distance: A sensor in % cannot measure a distance. Choose measurement Level.

remove_threshold.title: Remove thresholds
remove_threshold.description: Their entities are removed as well.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: Reached at or beyond the value; cleared once the level has moved back by the hysteresis.

data_description.name: E.g. Warning level 1, Reserve or Overflow.
data_description.value: Level in cm, same reference as the level sensor.
data_description.direction: Rising thresholds for floods and full tanks, falling ones for low water and reserves.
data_description.hysteresis: How far the level must move back before the threshold clears. Prevents messages when it wobbles.
data_description.color: Color of this stage in the card. Empty: orange when rising, blue when falling.
data_description.notify: Notify when the threshold is reached.
data_description.targets: Companion app, persistent notification in Home Assistant, Telegram, e-mail or any other notify service.
data_description.critical: Companion app only: sounds even in silent mode (iOS critical alert, Android alarm channel).
data_description.message: Empty for the default text. Placeholders: {name}, {threshold}, {value}, {level}, {trend}, {rate}.
data_description.clear_message: Notify again when the threshold clears.
data_description.repeat: Repeat the message while the threshold holds. 0 = once.

advanced.name: Trend and data quality
advanced.description: Fine tuning; the defaults suit most sensors.

data_description.trend_window: Period over which the rate of change is computed.
data_description.trend_deadband: Rates within ± this value count as stable.
data_description.smoothing: Median over this period removes single outliers. 0 = off.
data_description.stale_timeout: Data counts as stale if the sensor reports nothing for this long.
data_description.max_jump: Larger jumps are ignored until 3 readings confirm them. 0 = off.
data_description.consumption_window: Tank only: period over which the daily consumption is averaged.
data_description.refill_jump: Tank only: a rise by at least this much within two hours counts as refill and restarts the consumption. 0 = off.

preset_values.title: Template values
preset_values.description: Enter the values you need in cm, leave the others empty. Names, colors and directions are set; you can change them later.
